notes: encoding::binary: Go's ByteOrder and AppendByteOrder traits with BigEndian, LittleEndian and NativeEndian; fixed-size values through the FixedSize trait; Go-compatible varints, differential-checked by tools/encoding_conformance.py. Deviations forced by Rust: Go's reflection-based Read, Write, Size, Encode, Decode and Append accept only FixedSize types (bool, 8 to 64-bit integers, floats, slices and arrays of them), and structs are rejected at compile time instead of at run time; ByteOrder covers the 16, 32 and 64-bit operations that Go defines. Fallible calls return io::Result where Go panics on short buffers (put and buffer-form calls report UnexpectedEof; overflow reports InvalidData). Read and ReadUvarint report io.EOF and io.ErrUnexpectedEOF as io::Error values of kind UnexpectedEof carrying crate::io::Error::Eof or crate::io::Error::UnexpectedEof. Append and AppendUvarint return () and extend the Vec in place
